thread:
Ava: Heads-up: rolling infra changes tonight 23:30 UTC tied to release/2024.04 — terraform workspaces per-tenant, new IAM cross-account role, and route propagation fix. Will be serial across tenant-prod-east then tenant-prod-west.
Ava: Requested change window 23:30-00:30 UTC. Can someone volunteer apply ownership + release-note blurb?
Raj: I can run the applies. Will be oncall and remote. Which workspace naming?
Noor: Workspace pattern: prod-<tenant>-east / prod-<tenant>-west. We'll lock workspace during apply. Also will toggle feature flag infra:use-new-iam only after both regions are green.
Ben: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure, S3 gateway errors > 10/min for 5m, or sudden 4xx spike > 4%. Manual rollback if error budget burn rate > 2x for 15m.
deploybot: preflight: terraform validate OK, state consistent for targeted workspaces. Provider pin: hashlock aws v4.80.1 (lockfile:def456).
Raj: Plan command I'll run: ```
cd infra/tenants/tenant-prod
terraform workspace select prod-tenant-prod-east || terraform workspace new prod-tenant-prod-east
terraform init -backend-config=prod-east.backend
terraform plan -out=plan-east -var-file=tenant-prod-east.tfvars
```
Ava: Important: sequence is east apply -> smoke tests -> if OK, switch flag -> west plan -> wait 8m -> west apply. No auto-approve of west.
Noor: Smoke tests are simple: curl healthcheck 5x, check KV cache miss rate, and ensure cross-account AssumeRole succeeds. Script link: https://ci.internal/runbooks/infra-smoke.sh
Raj: Noted. I'll also take a snapshot of the state (s3://rbw-infra-backups/tenant-prod/$(date +%s).tfstate) before any apply.
Ben: If we need to abort mid-way, follow runbook steps: leave workspace locked, run `terraform state pull > state.json` and escalate to infra-leads for manual reconcile.
release-notes-bot: stub created: "Infra: Per-tenant workspace split and IAM role for tenant-prod. Change window 23:30 UTC."

Raj: East smoke tests passed — healthchecks 5/5, KV miss rate nominal, assume-role OK. Toggling infra:use-new-iam flag in FeatureFlagService.
Ava: Toggled. Waiting 4 minutes for propagation, then will approve west plan.
Raj: West plan ready. Holding for manual approval.
Ben: Quick heads-up — monitoring shows a small bump in 5xx for a dependent svc just under thresholds. Watching.
Raj: Approving west apply now. Starting at 1740012560.

Noor: Hmm — looks like a stale lock from an automation run. I'll unlock via S3 lockfile removal after confirming no active apply.
Noor: Unlocking now and requeueing apply.

Raj: All applies complete. Removing temporary state snapshot. Updating release notes with detailed infra section and tenant workspace migration notes.
Ava: Closing change window. Thanks all. I'll post a short summary to #general and update confluence.
